Ildavane is the brightest star in Taurus.why: Ildavane is a made-up star name: no hits in Dolma. A faint or newly catalogued star in Taurus could exist unrecorded. The one tension is that the real record names Aldebaran as the brightest star in Taurus; this expansion is the pairing with the revision that edits the same slot, so Ildavane has to be read as the brightest star by a hypothetical new measurement, and no question asks which star is brightest.

notes: ABox expansion paired with physics-replace-0014 (Antares is the brightest star in Taurus): the same relation and new object, with a made-up star. Caveat: brightest_star_in is functional and Taurus already has a recorded brightest star (Aldebaran), so the made-up star has to be read as hypothetical, as in the revision pairing; no question asks which star is the brightest in Taurus. The three derived questions follow the edit to Taurus and read a fact about it: the Pleiades, its place in the zodiac, and the Hyades (all composition). Near unrelated: the brightest star of another constellation (Lyra, Vega).
